title: Stovetop Buttered Popcorn
summary: Kernels are heated in oil with a test-kernel trick, popped with the lid ajar until the popping slows, then tossed with melted butter and salt.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Test the heat
steps.text: Heat the oil with 3 kernels, covered, until they pop.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Add the rest of the kernels off the heat, cover and wait 30 seconds.

steps.title: Pop
steps.text: Cook with the lid slightly open, shaking, until pops come 2 seconds apart.

steps.title: Butter
steps.text: Toss with melted butter, then with salt.

steps.title: Settle
steps.text: Leave 2-3 minutes so the popcorn crisps before serving.

tips: Keep the lid ajar so steam escapes and the popcorn stays crisp.
Take it off the heat as soon as popping slows to avoid burning.
Fine salt sticks better than flaky salt.
storage: Keep cooled popcorn in an airtight container for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
